title: Compact Cluster Operability Timeline Cards
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Goal: Design a compact, single-line / condensed card module to surface recent operability signals for Private/VPC clusters on tenant dashboards. The card should fit into existing tenant overview grids and be scannable by SREs and platform owners during incident triage and routine checks.

Background: Private tenants run clusters across regions with tight screen real estate on the dedicated overview. Current status surfaces are verbose (full banners or drill-in pages) and slow for quick rhythm-of-work checks. We need a condensed card that communicates: cluster health (ok/warn/critical), recent network events (eg degraded peering, packet loss spike), last upgrade window and its outcome, and a small confidence / remediation hint (eg auto-rollback enabled).

Primary users: platform SREs, infra PMs, customer success engineers.

Design constraints: must be readable at 280px card width, accessible color contrast at AA, support localization for short strings, and remain clickable to expand to full status timeline. Prioritize information hierarchy: 1) health dot and cluster name, 2) latest incident dot with short label, 3) upgrade status (icon + short string), 4) latency/egress anomaly indicator, 5) quick action overflow (ops playbook).

Success metrics: 1) average time-to-triage for common networking incidents reduced by 18% in pilot tenants; 2) >60% of SREs report being able to identify next action from card without drilling in during usability testing; 3) no regressions in accessibility audits.

Acceptance criteria: See acceptance_criteria field.

Notes on implementation handoff: Provide a Figma spec with tokenized spacing and color variables. Provide copy variants for compact vs expanded modes. Coordinate with runtime/infra for an aggregated small JSON endpoint (<= 4 keys) to avoid heavy per-card calls; engineering prefers a single batch API keyed by tenant_id to fill multiple cards at once.
acceptance_criteria: Card fits 280px width and legible at 12px body copy
Health state (green/amber/red) + cluster name visible without hover
Single-line recent-event summary (max 28 chars) updates dynamically
Upgrade state shows icon + timestamp; clicking opens rollout timeline panel
Compact action menu includes: open playbook, acknowledge incident, open logs
Performance: client-side rendering of 20 cards should not exceed 150ms after batch API response
Design tokens provided and verified in Figma; color contrast AA
comments: 2025-02-12 - Aisha Raman: Initial ticket created with objectives, constraints, and target users. Flagging dependency on lightweight batch API (ENG-88912).
2025-02-15 - Markus Lee: Early sketches uploaded to Figma (link above). Chose condensed timeline microchart vs sparkline after comparing scan speed in hallway testing.

2025-02-18 - Priya Nair (PM): PM review - prefer explicit 'Last upgrade: success/failure' label rather than ambiguous checkmark. Also requested CTA for 'request support' when upgrade failed. Added to acceptance criteria.

2025-02-21 - Eng (Luca Fernandez): Feasibility note - batch endpoint possible but needs cache TTL negotiation for per-tenant freshness. Suggested 30s TTL for overview surface to avoid backend pressure. Added ENG-88912 as dependency.
2025-02-24 - Accessibility review (Maya Ortiz): Contrast of amber on white failed AA for small text. Adjusted accent color tokens and updated Figma mockups.
2025-02-26 - Usability test, n=6 SREs: 5/6 could identify next action; testers asked for an inline 'severity' tooltip. Added microcopy and iconography guidance.

2025-03-01 - Design review with Console team: Reviewed compact vs expanded behavior. Decided to show micro timeline only in expanded panel; compact card will show up to 1 event summary and an overflow menu.
2025-03-03 - Markus Lee: Updated specs and included CSS token names; handing off to ENG for sprint planning. Next: ENG estimate for batch API and small payload schema (ENG-88912).
release_notes: Introduce compact operability timeline cards to tenant overview in Private Console. Cards provide at-a-glance cluster health, latest network event, and last upgrade status with quick actions. Feature gated and enabled for pilot tenants only in console-2025.03.
